in_hebrew.name: אֵלִישֶׁבֶת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Hebrew word אֵל (El) meaning 'God' and שֶׁבֶת (shevet) meaning 'abundance' or 'prosperity'. It is a feminine name and is found in the Old Testament as the name of the wife of Saul and later of David. However, the name 'Lisle' itself is not biblical.

in_greek.name: Λισσα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek form of the Hebrew name אֵלִישֶׁבֶת (Elishebat) is Λισσα (Lissa). It is derived from the Greek form of the Hebrew word אֵל (El) meaning 'God' and שֶׁבֶת (shevet) meaning 'abundance' or 'prosperity'. The name 'Lisle' itself is not biblical in Greek.

in_latin.name: Lisbia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the Hebrew name אֵלִישֶׁבֶת (Elishebat) is Lisbia. It is derived from the Latinized form of the Hebrew word אֵל (El) meaning 'God' and שֶׁבֶת (shevet) meaning 'abundance' or 'prosperity'. The name 'Lisle' itself is not biblical in Latin.
